finding: No literal signed downward-progress penalty. State proximity and engagement rewards can nevertheless favor remaining near a jam over initially withdrawing.
decision: Keep upstream reward pending matched full-trajectory checks. If a shared study correction is justified, retain the official reference and rerun all affected arms.
required_next_check: Match initial seed/fault and total job horizon. Record per-term rewards for a witnessed contact stall versus feasible successful retract/reinsert. Compare full discounted returns, not single-step Z movement. Exclude rewards after evaluator termination from job results and explicitly define training terminal handling.
scope_and_limitations: Source and analytic component audit, not proof that PPO can learn recovery.
Two distances ignore engagement, force, actions, prediction and future success; they are not complete rewards or rollout returns.
Current short scripted probes do not include a verified successful recovery after a contact jam.
